description:
NinjaTrader 8 is running on the Windows desktop with real historical data for SPY (SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust).

A swing trader needs a specific chart setup to monitor long-term trends while trading on a daily timeframe. 

Your task:
1. Open a new Chart for 'SPY' using 'Daily' bars.
2. Add a SECOND Data Series to this SAME chart using 'Weekly' bars (this is an overlay, not a separate chart window).
3. Add an 'SMA' (Simple Moving Average) indicator with a Period of 50.
4. CRITICAL: Configure the SMA indicator to use the 'Weekly' data series as its 'Input Series' (instead of the default Daily series).
5. Save the workspace so the configuration persists.

The final result should be a single chart window showing Daily candles with a Weekly 50-SMA line overlaid.

Login credentials (if needed): Docker / GymAnything123!
